county_relationship.note: Counties come from each facility's resolved county. A ZIP can span several counties; the HUD USPS crosswalk (with weights) is not yet configured. Census ZCTAs approximate, but are not, USPS ZIP codes.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.
Honor the resident's right to share a room with spouse or roommate of choice and receive written notice before a change is made.
Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure the activities program is directed by a qualified professional.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Conduct and document a facility-wide assessment to determine what resources are necessary to care for residents competently during both day-to-day operations (including nights and weekends) and emergencies.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
